next_actions.title: Turn on SIM lock (port-out PIN) with your carrier
next_actions.note: Completely cuts this entire cascade at root origin.
next_actions.why: Enabling carrier port-out PIN prevents unauthorized SIM swapping and invalidates attacker interception.

next_actions.title: Remove SMS OTP direct login from Amazon
next_actions.why: Requires attacker to possess password instead of only SMS interception.

next_actions.note: Prevents 5 round-2 accounts from falling if phone number is compromised.
next_actions.why: Blocks SMS recovery gate on the primary SSO provider.
